pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with smooth pixel gradients at the edges due to image resolution. Shapes range from sub-rectangular to pentagonal with relatively uniform spatial distribution across the flank and lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored topological graph separating the patches. Features defined junction nodes where three to four pathways meet, with consistent pixel thickness and connectivity across the visible midsection.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the upper neck, appearing as a continuous dark fringe against the background.
